content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on sales invoice:new, the Apply control received five clicks at the same spot within about 1 s (events 279, 283, 287, 290 and 294 in session S87ed6f63), which suggests the first click gave no clear response so users repeated it.", "fix": "Fix: on the sales invoice:new screen, give the Apply button immediate visible feedback on the first click, such as disabling it and showing a busy state until the update completes.", "cited_event_ids": ["279", "283", "287", "290", "294"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The events do not show what the UI displayed after each Apply click, so a missing response is not confirmed.", "No Apply result or error tied to these clicks appears in the windows.", "No abandonment is observed; the impact is limited to a median of about 1.1 s lost per affected user."]}
